summary.key_theme: 市場高度看好 Quanta Services 作為 AI 基礎設施與電力供應的關鍵參與者，儘管估值面臨過高疑慮。

bullish.title: ‘AI Plays in Disguise’ – Analyst Highlights Quanta Services (PWR) as a Promising AI Power Stock

bullish.title: Wall Street Analysts See a 26.52% Upside in Quanta Services (PWR): Can the Stock Really Move This High?
bullish.reason: 華爾街分析師給出高達 26.52 % 的潛在上漲空間，反映市場對其未來獲利成長的強烈信心。

bullish.title: Quanta Services (PWR) is an Incredible Growth Stock: 3 Reasons Why

bullish.title: Are Wall Street Analysts Bullish on Quanta Services Stock?
